metadata.desc: OpenViking long-term memory for AstrBot — peer model: the bot is the self and every person is a peer; auto-capture conversations, semantic recall, and per-person profiles.

ov_base_url.description: OpenViking server URL (must be a peer-contract build, i.e. OpenViking with PR #2236 or later)

ov_admin_api_key.description: Admin API key (only used in venue mode to mint a per-venue OV user)

ov_user_api_key.description: User API key. Used directly as the bot self identity in global mode (recommended)

ov_account_id.description: OV account ID (auto-parsed from API key if empty; only needed when minting in venue mode)

self_scope.description: Memory owner (self) granularity: global (one bot self, peers shared across venues, default) | venue (per-group self, peers isolated per group)

global_user_id.description: Name of the minted bot-self user in global mode when only an admin key is available (ignored if a User Key is set)

isolation_overrides.description: Per-group self_scope overrides as JSON, e.g. {"123456": "venue"}. Legacy values are auto-mapped.

peer_enabled.description: Tag incoming messages with peer_id and commit with self+peer policy, building a per-person profile under viking://user/<bot>/peers/<sender>/ (off = self-only memory)

peer_recall_scope.description: Which peers to recall: speaker (self + current speaker) | speaker_plus_active (also recently-active members, default) | none (self only)

peer_recall_active_window.description: Max recently-active members also recalled in speaker_plus_active mode

trusted_mode.description: Send X-OpenViking-Account/User identity headers (only for OV servers running auth_mode=trusted behind a gateway); leave off for standard api_key servers

auto_recall_enabled.description: Auto-recall memories on every LLM request

recall_limit.description: Max number of memory entries to recall

recall_min_score.description: Minimum semantic score threshold for recall

recall_token_budget.description: Max tokens for injected recall context

commit_message_threshold.description: Auto-commit after this many pending messages

commit_token_threshold.description: Auto-commit when pending tokens exceed this

commit_idle_seconds.description: Auto-commit after this many seconds of inactivity (also the recent window for peer recall)

ingest_attachments.description: Push images/files to OV resources for VLM indexing

capture_tool_io.description: Capture LLM tool call inputs/outputs as structured tool parts

capture_image_caption.description: Capture AstrBot's image-to-text caption (bot-directed images only) as memory, marked as image-derived. Ignored when caption_all_images is on

caption_all_images.description: Actively transcribe EVERY image (incl. ambient group images, not just bot-directed) by calling a vision provider per image. Costs one VLM call per image

image_caption_provider_id.description: Provider ID used to transcribe images (empty = AstrBot's default_image_caption_provider_id). Required for caption_all_images

image_caption_prompt.description: Prompt for image transcription (empty = AstrBot's image_caption_prompt or a built-in Chinese default)

backfill_on_first_seen.description: Pull historical messages when a venue is first seen

backfill_max_messages.description: Max messages to backfill per venue

backfill_max_age_days.description: Only backfill messages from the last N days

backfill_batch_size.description: Messages per batch when writing backfill to OV

bypass_patterns.description: Regex patterns to skip OV operations for matching venue IDs
